x: The Surrey Walking Club men have a habit of producing their best walking soon after six miles, but although Hake and Burt walked very strongly over the last part of the journey and picked up many valuable points, they could not get up to our leaders.
In the 2 miles walk we called upon Brown and Harley, to take on Cooper, Hake and Co., and in finishing 4th and 6th they did as well as could be expected.
…onsolation was to see Don Brown in good fettle once again, and showing excellent form though playing "second fiddle" to Hake, who created a new record for the course in 1 hour 17 mins. 17 secs.…
Later Hake (S.W.C.) came through, and in the latter stages of the race a great duel was fought out between Redman and Hake, the first named prevailing by a few yards.
